desc: Read input (N, K, arrays A, B, C) with fast integer parsing.
Sort A descending, B descending, C ascending.
Generate list of K best pairs (i,j) of A_i·B_j using a max-heap and visited set.
Implement count_ge(X) using the precomputed pairs and bisect_left on C.
Binary search on X in range [0, max possible value] to find smallest X with count >= K.
Print the answer and test with sample inputs.
